title: 脳科学
subtitle: Brain Science
educationalGoal: The brain is a command and control center that responds to environmental changes. This course aims to understand what is happening in the brain, which is composed of 100 billion neurons, when we see, hear, talk, and think. We focus not only on rational behavior, but also on emotions and even unconsciousness, and consider why the brain developed from an evolutionary perspective.
advice: The course will provide information which should enable the student to explain: 1. Historical views of human brain (trephination). 2. Cellular and chemical machinery of the brain (regulation of neuronal activity, neuronal communication). 3. Human brain structure and function (localization of brain function). 4. Vertebrate brain structure and evolution (forebrain, midbrain, hindbrain). 5. Enlargement of human brain (scaling, allometry, selective pressure). 6. Brain malfunction and mental disorder (clinical depression, ADHD, Parkinson’s disease, etc.). 7. Stress disorder (acute stress disorder, chronic stress disorder, fight or flight response). 8. Development of the brain (neuronal specificity, neuronal plasticity). 9. Right brain and left brain (bisected brain, corpus callosum, hemispheric specialization and dominance). 10. Rational brain (rational choice, decision making). 11. Consciousness and unconsciousness (mind-body problem, the Libet experiment, free will). 12. Personality and temperament (genetic polymorphism, national character, novelty seeking). 13. Evolution of human sociality and emotion (fear, aggression, pain, the limbic system). 14. Cognition (cognitive dissonance theory, cognitive bias, confirmation bias). 15. Self and others (self-recognition, selfishness, altruism, theory of mind, lies, evil). 16. Human brain and artificial intelligence (neural network, deep learning, qualia, hard problems).
requiredKnowledge: General knowledge of neuroscience and evolution are required. In order to understand the information presented, it is necessary to regularly study the background information.
